categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Garden Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: vitamins and pharmaceutical manufacturing. The vitamin segment focuses on the research, production, and sales of Vitamin D3, Vitamin A, wool grease cholesterol, and related products. The pharmaceutical segment specializes in high-barrier formulations for chronic diseases, including cardiovascular and neurological drugs, with key products such as valsartan amlodipine tablets and doxophylline injection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced production technologies including Vitamin D3 synthesis, NF-grade cholesterol production, and 25-hydroxy Vitamin D3 manufacturing, all recognized with national and industry awards. It maintains three R&D centers focusing on natural product biosynthesis, industrial research, chemical automation, and drug development. Production adheres to GMP standards with strict quality control and uses a sales-driven production model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include feed, pharmaceutical, and food industries for vitamins, and hospitals for pharmaceutical products. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant export volumes in vitamins. Major pharmaceutical products are included in national and provincial centralized procurement programs, enhancing market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Dongyang and Jinhua, Zhejiang Province. It has a nationwide sales network covering most regions in China and exports vitamins globally, accounting for a substantial portion of revenue. The company also maintains strategic partnerships with international producers and distributors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Garden Biopharmaceutical controls a full Vitamin D3 industry chain from upstream raw materials like wool grease cholesterol to downstream active Vitamin D3 drugs and nutritional products. It operates both upstream (raw material production) and downstream (finished vitamin and pharmaceutical products), positioning itself as an integrated player in the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding its vitamin and pharmaceutical product lines through continuous R&D investment, focusing on innovative synthesis technologies and high-barrier generic drugs. It aims to develop new products in chronic disease treatment and enhance production efficiency. Ongoing projects include fermentation-based amino acid production and advanced vitamin formulations, supported by provincial high-tech centers and national awards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of vitamins, pharmaceutical drugs, and related chemical products. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors for vitamins and a combined distributor plus academic promotion model for pharmaceuticals. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in Vitamin D3 full-chain production and a major player in China's vitamin and pharmaceutical markets. It holds a competitive advantage with low production costs and advanced technologies. Its pharmaceutical segment competes in the high-end generic drug market, adapting to national procurement policies and medical reforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.24 billion, a 13.58% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 309 million, up 60.76%. Total assets reached RMB 5.61 billion, growing 6.69%. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased production efficiency and expanded product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Garden Biopharmaceutical emphasizes its unique full-industry chain integration for Vitamin D3 products, enabling cost leadership and quality control. Its advanced production technologies and continuous innovation provide high-quality vitamins and pharmaceuticals. The company’s strategic participation in national procurement and strong R&D capabilities differentiate it in the competitive pharmaceutical market.
